item.text: The campaign is ready with a $550 lifetime cap and $110 daily pacing, ending at midnight Eastern after Halloween. I’m starting with the ghost-story post: it explains the family-language benefit, the trial, and phone availability. US, iPhone, and Android phone targeting are saved, with audience expansion off.
The first check shows $26.16 spent, 28,853 impressions, and 11 link clicks. Delivery is working and spend is within budget; there’s no trial-start evidence available to justify a creative change yet.
Through Thursday’s midday check, spend is $149.03 with 119,001 impressions and 64 link clicks. Pacing is close to plan, so I’m keeping the current setup.

item.text: Friday’s check shows $246.26 spent and 105 link clicks, about $2.35 per click. I’ve raised daily pacing to $130 to use the remaining budget over the weekend; the total cap remains $550.
Saturday’s totals are $361.03 spent, 303,378 impressions, and 158 link clicks. That leaves $188.97 under the cap for the rest of the weekend. Delivery remains steady.
At Halloween’s midday check, the campaign has spent $461.31 and generated 201 link clicks. I’ll watch the remaining $88.69 through tonight’s cutoff.
The evening check shows $497.40 spent and 215 link clicks, still within the total cap. The scheduled cutoff remains midnight Eastern.
The flight has ended, and the campaign and ad group are paused. I’m allowing another hour for reporting to update before pulling the recap.

The Halloween campaign wrapped up at midnight Eastern after October 31 and is now paused.
